scope: Software and acquisition attempts preceding any methylation cohort model results
acquisition_v1: Six series matrices passed EOF/CRC; two liver transfers were truncated and rejected. Full liver matrices were subsequently acquired with size and CRC checks, recorded in acquisition_supplement.json.
methylation_transfer_v1: Stopped during text parsing: scalar float dtype incorrectly included probe identifier strings. No models fitted or scores generated.
methylation_transfer_v2: Preparation completed but model loading stopped because pandas string-extension probe IDs serialized as object arrays. Native GSE61258 HealthyObese spelling was also corrected to implement the declared inclusion of healthy obese controls. No model scores generated.
methylation_transfer_v3: Use explicitly typed Unicode NPZ probe IDs and exact native label mapping. Biological source files, outcome definitions, feature grid and target cohorts remain the declared protocol.
method_tests_attempt1: One test used exact float32/float64 equality; two existing tests encountered a locked shared temporary directory. The assertion was changed to numerical tolerance and the complete suite rerun in a fresh isolated temporary directory with cache disabled.
